notes: Recorded per-turn-kind pass rates for the two co-resident split-serving models. pass_rate = passed/samples where a sample is one run of the frozen fixture scored by app/model_routing.py::score_envelope (envelope parses, kind matches, required variant fields present). Values consolidate the recorded evidence named in each row's source; they are not a fresh controlled benchmark. Regenerate against live models with `python3 scripts/record_model_routing.py --base-url http://192.168.1.17:52417/v1 --models structured=mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-Next-4bit,reasoning=mlx-community/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking-4bit --turns 3`. A turn kind with no row for a role means that role was never recorded for it; the routing derivation then uses the rows that do exist.
